test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: To which of the following states does the folk dance form ‘Grida’ belong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Grida__ is the folk dance form of Madhya Pradesh.

 __
 
• Once the winter season's rabi crop is ready for harvest, the villagers celebrate by performing the Grida Dance and celebrating their labour and hard work.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
